हनुमान जी अपनी ही ताकत भूल गए थे। क्यों? 🔊

As a child he leapt for the sun, thinking it was a fruit. The sages cursed him to forget his power until someone reminded him. Years later, at the edge of an endless ocean, Jambavan did: "You are the son of the wind. This task was made for you."

We all have a Hanuman inside us. Sometimes we just need a Jambavan.

Send this to the friend who has forgotten their strength 💛

Which part of Hanuman's story do you love most? 👇

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Kishkindha Kanda (Jambavan's words) and Uttara Kanda (the childhood curse).
